cases.question: What evidence is there for directive 5 and when did the Atlas last review it?
cases.rawModelText: Directive 5 directs CalSTA, in coordination with Caltrans and the CTC, to update state funding program guidelines, and directs Caltrans to identify federal funding programs. The Atlas links four reviewed evidence records to this directive. The evidence collection was last swept 2026-08-21; the next planned sweep is 2026-09-18. | First, a July 15, 2026 reference material item from the California Transportation Commission, Atlas last reviewed 2026-07-22: | Second, a workshop presentation from the same date, also Atlas last reviewed 2026-07-22: | Third, a staff recommendation item for the 2026 Solutions for Congested Corridors Program Guidelines, Atlas last reviewed 2026-08-21: | Fourth, a staff recommendation item for the 2026 Local Partnership Competitive Program Guidelines, also Atlas last reviewed 2026-08-21: | The Atlas's analysis flags two open implementation questions for this directive: which guideline cycles and owners apply, and how transit priority, connectivity, and incentive magnitude are defined. All four records address only portions of the state-guideline clause; none address Caltrans's federal-funding-identification clause.
